app.tagline: One photo becomes a Thai · English · Japanese copy laid out like the original
app.upload: Upload a tax invoice or receipt photo
app.uploadHint: Drop a photo here or pick one. On a phone you can take it right away.
app.noAi: AI reading isn't available here. Open this page while signed in to claude.ai.
app.noImage: This view can't send photos to the AI.
app.aiFail: Couldn't read the document. The photo may be blurry or cut off. Retake it in good light with the whole page visible.
app.notDoc: This doesn't look like a receipt or tax invoice. Try another photo.
app.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
app.badImage: This image format can't be read. Use JPG or PNG.
app.saveFail: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
app.notGranted: You don't have permission to save. Ask the page owner for access.
app.photoNotSaved: No permission to store photos, so only the details were saved.
app.noDb: Storage isn't connected. Open this page while signed in to claude.ai.
app.sVatNote: Full tax invoices to our company
app.empty: No documents yet. Upload a photo above.
app.foot: Tax IDs are checked with the Revenue Department check-digit rule. Confirm with your accountant before filing.

checks.items: Lines: qty × price = amount, sum matches
checks.claimWindow: Input VAT claim window (6 months after the invoice month)

detail.noCompany: Add our company tax ID in settings below to compare
detail.differ: Differs from our company · VAT may not be claimable
detail.checkPhoto: Compare the dotted fields with the photo
detail.dupFound: Same seller and document number already in the ledger

photo.noBox: No position data for this field. Zoom into the photo to check it.

review.invalid: Some fields have the wrong format. Check the red fields.

settings.title: Settings
settings.formDesc: Change the block order, visible fields and field names of the organized form. Applies to the whole company.
settings.blocksHint: Use the arrows to reorder and the switches to hide blocks. Seller, customer, items and totals always stay.
settings.fieldsHint: Turning a field off hides it in view mode only. Edit mode still shows every field.
settings.labelsHint: Fill in only the languages you want to change. Empty means the default name.
settings.resetDone: Reset to defaults. Press Save to apply.

ui.reviewHint: Compare with the original and review the fields that need attention.
ui.originalHint: Zoom or rotate to inspect. Select a review badge to jump to its location.
ui.checksHint: Start with the items that need attention.
ui.workspaceIntro: Review the original beside its organized form, and check amounts and document details.
ui.sampleIntro: Explore a trilingual form, photo zoom, and automatic checks with the PANFOOD sample.
ui.settingsIntro: Arrange blocks, choose visible fields, and rename labels with a live preview.
ui.previewNotice: Sample review and form settings are available now. Photo upload, ledger storage, and sign-in are still in development.

batch.title: Read documents from photos
batch.intro: Upload up to {max} tax invoice or receipt photos at once and the AI reads them all at the same time.
batch.formats: JPG · PNG · HEIC (iPhone) · one document per photo
batch.limit: You can upload up to {max} photos at once. {count} were left out.
batch.full: All {max} photos are in. Remove one to add another.
batch.noKey: No AI key yet. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to .env.local and restart the server.
batch.network: The connection dropped. Check your internet and tap Read again.
batch.busy: The AI is busy right now. Wait a moment and tap Read again.
batch.checkHint: The AI may misread it. Retake it, or read it as it is.

del.title: Delete this document?
del.desc: It disappears from the ledger right away and is kept in the trash. Admins can restore it any time.
del.reasonPh: Say why it is being deleted
del.shredding: Moving the document to the trash…
del.done: Moved to the trash. Admins can restore it.
del.sampleDone: This is the sample, so it was not actually deleted.

trash.empty: No documents in the ledger yet. Upload a photo to start.
trash.notFound: Document not found. It may have been deleted.
trash.inTrash: This document is in the trash
trash.adminOnlyTrash: Only admins can see the trash.

archive.drafted: Saved as a draft. Continue from Ledger › Drafts.
archive.draftNote: Drafts are not in the monthly totals. Open one and tap ‘Save to ledger’ to move it into the ledger.
archive.stickerHint: Sort documents with colour stickers. A document can have several, and you can rename them for your company.
archive.search: Search by seller, document no. or amount

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Enter the email you were invited with and we will send a sign-in link. No password needed.
auth.sent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Tap it and you are in.
auth.notInvited: This email has not been invited. Ask an admin for an invitation.
auth.fail: Could not send the link. Please try again shortly.
auth.tooSoon: A link was just sent. Try again in a minute.
auth.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new sign-in link.
auth.notMember: You are signed in but not registered as a company member. Please contact an admin.
auth.removed: Your access was removed and you were signed out. Contact an admin if you need it back.
auth.expired: For security, you were signed out {hours} hours after signing in. Please sign in again.
auth.keepSigned: Once signed in, you stay signed in on this device for {hours} hours.
auth.codeHint: If the link opens in a different browser on your phone, enter the 6-digit code from the email here.
auth.codeWrong: That code is wrong or expired. Check the newest email, or get a new link.
auth.about: A ledger where AI reads Thai tax invoices and receipts.

members.title: Members
members.hint: Only invited people can sign in. An invite sends a sign-up email in 4 languages.
members.lastAdmin: There must be at least one admin.
members.namePh: Name shown in records such as deletions
members.sendEmailHint: Email a sign-in link (also resends the invite)
members.rate: Just sent. Try again in a minute.
members.removeDesc: They are signed out right away and can no longer use the ledger, photos or the LINE bot. Their documents and history stay. You can restore access later.
members.self: You can't remove your own access.

export.printHint: In the print dialog, choose 'Save as PDF' as the printer.
export.empty: No documents to export for this month.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.hint: Saving a document registers its seller by tax ID. A corrected name is also used for documents read later.
vendors.empty: No vendors yet. They appear when documents are saved to the ledger.

dash.title: Dashboard
dash.trendHint: Net total of the documents saved each month
dash.companyMissing: Set our company tax ID to calculate claimable VAT.

line.title: LINE
line.hint: Send receipt photos to the LINE bot and the AI reads them straight into the ledger. The bot replies in Thai and Japanese.
line.codeHint: Add the LINE bot as a friend and send it this code in a 1:1 chat. It works for 10 minutes.
line.step1: Scan the QR code with the LINE app to add the bot as a friend. On a phone, tap the button below instead.
line.step3: Send the code to the bot in the LINE chat and you're connected. The code works for 10 minutes.
line.qrAlt: QR code to add the LINE bot as a friend

report.title: Input Tax Report
report.otherHint: Abbreviated receipts · not addressed to our company · required items missing · claim period passed · forbidden input VAT (entertainment, passenger cars) · copies of invoices
report.note: Prepared from the documents recorded in the ledger. Check against the original documents before filing.
report.companyMissing: Enter our company tax ID in Settings to show the taxpayer details and claimable input tax.

lock.confirmDesc: Locks a month whose tax return is filed. Once closed, its saved documents can't be edited, deleted or added to. Payment and stickers can still change, and an admin can reopen it any time.
lock.fail: Couldn't change it. Only admins can close or reopen a month.
lock.blocked: This month is closed. To edit, an admin has to reopen it in the ledger.
lock.docBanner: This document's month is closed. Its contents can't change; only payment and stickers can. To edit, an admin has to reopen the month in the ledger.

vat.title: VAT return · {month}
vat.todoHint: Sort out the documents to check and the drafts first, so the report is right.
vat.readyHint: Ready. Check the report, file the return, then close the month.
vat.doneHint: This month is closed. Its documents won't change.

bulk.hint: Tick the documents you paid. Only unpaid ones are shown.
bulk.confirmDesc: Amounts to transfer per vendor. Check the payment date.
bulk.fail: Couldn't change them. Check the connection and try again.

tax.claimHint: A late-received invoice can be claimed in the month it arrived. If the invoice month is closed, saving puts it in the next open month. A late claim must be noted on the invoice ('ถือเป็นภาษีซื้อในเดือนภาษี…') and is allowed up to 6 months after the invoice month.
tax.noHint: Entertainment, and passenger cars (≤10 seats: purchase, hire, fuel, repairs) can't be claimed even on a full tax invoice (§82/5). If so, choose 'Don't claim'.
tax.blockedHint: This document's VAT is not claimed ({category}). It goes under 'Other purchases' in the report.
tax.whtHint: Choose it when tax is withheld on paying services, rent, etc. It goes on the certificate (50 ทวิ) and the monthly filing list.
tax.movedTo: {month} is closed, so it was saved as a claim in {to}.

whtList.title: Withholding tax list (ภ.ง.ด.53 · ภ.ง.ด.3)
whtList.note: Only documents marked paid in this month with a withholding (by payment month). Tax IDs starting with 0 are treated as companies (ภ.ง.ด.53), 1–8 as individuals (ภ.ง.ด.3). Condition 1 = withheld at payment. Check against the originals before filing.

whtDoc.title: Withholding tax certificate (50 ทวิ)
whtDoc.banner: This document has a withholding. You can print the certificate (50 ทวิ) for the vendor.
whtDoc.unpaid: Not paid yet, so the payment date is blank.

purge.title: Delete for good?
purge.desc: The {name} document and its photo will be deleted permanently and can't be brought back. Only a record of what was deleted, and by whom, stays. Saved documents of a closed month can't be deleted.
purge.locked: This document is in a closed month and can't be deleted. Reopen the month first.
purge.fail: Couldn't delete it. Only admins can delete documents from the trash.
